name: issue-creator/constraints
prompt: Add CSV export to the reports page. Don't change the existing JSON API. An export of 10,000 rows must finish in under 5 seconds. PDF export is out of scope.

grade.label: body with a Constraints section after the criteria passes idd-lint
every constraint is labelled, confidence-marked and taken from the reporter's text
created issue is read back before reporting completion

criteria: The Constraints section holds only boundaries the reporter stated, never one inferred from code.
Each item carries one Non-goal/Invariant/Limit label and a confidence marker.
The section is omitted when the reporter stated no boundary.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests a fixture, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
